subject: Overremit on August invoice — request for adjustment and VAT invoice replacement
messages:
From: Ana Ruiz <ana.ruiz@acmetech.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>
Cc: billing@acmetech.com
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 08:12:00 +0100
Subject: Overremit on August invoice — duplicate remittance and VAT handling

Hi Olga / Chloe,

We've reviewed our August remittance and noticed a duplicate payment hit your account for INV-202608-9982. We paid the invoice on 2026-08-25 (EUR 48,120.00) but a second remittance cleared on 2026-08-29 for the same amount under a different reference (payment ref: ACME-RED-0829). Our AP team is asking for a formal correction so we can reconcile in our ledger.

We're VAT-registered in Ireland (VAT: IE352-1749-V). For accounting, we need:
- A credit memo for the duplicate payment (showing VAT breakdown)
- A reissued invoice or revised invoice showing the corrected VAT treatment (we use reverse charge for some services)
- Any supporting evidence from Redwood that the duplicate has been applied to our account or refunded, plus estimated timing

I've attached our VAT certificate for quick reference. Can you confirm the next steps and expected timeline? We prefer a credit (not a refund) applied against upcoming invoices — if that's possible.

Thanks,
Ana Ruiz
Finance Manager, AcmeTech
[attachment: acmetech_vat_certificate.pdf (application/pdf, 72KB)]
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Ana Ruiz <ana.ruiz@acmetech.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 10:03:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Overremit on August invoice — duplicate remittance and VAT handling

Hi Ana,

Thanks for flagging this and for sending the VAT certificate — I've downloaded it and shared with Finance. Apologies for the inconvenience.

Next steps from our side:
- I'll run this with Billing to confirm the duplicate payment trace and whether the second remittance was applied in error.
- If confirmed, we typically issue a credit memo that can be applied to future invoices; we can also do a refund if you prefer (please confirm).
- We'll reissue the invoice / VAT breakdown reflecting the correct treatment (reverse charge vs. standard VAT) once Finance confirms.

Can you confirm the PO number you want the credit memo applied to, and whether Acme prefers credit (applied) or a refund? If credit, we'll target applying it to your October invoice.

I'll follow up with a concrete timeline by EOD tomorrow after I speak with Marcus in Billing.

Best,
Olga Petrov
Revenue Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>
Cc: Ana Ruiz <ana.ruiz@acmetech.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2026 09:18:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Overremit on August invoice — duplicate remittance and VAT handling

Hi all,

I reviewed the payment flows: the second payment (ACME-RED-0829) was processed against the same invoice due to a reconciliation mismatch; Finance acknowledges the duplicate. Proposed resolution:

1) Issue a credit memo for EUR 48,120.00 (gross) referencing INV-202608-9982. Credit memo will include VAT breakdown and match Acme's VAT certificate.
2) Reissue a corrected invoice (INV-202608-9982-R) showing the intended VAT treatment (reverse charge) and zeroing out the duplicate when the credit is applied.
3) Apply the credit to your next billing cycle (Oct 2026) unless you request a refund.

I've attached a draft credit memo for internal review — it is a placeholder until we confirm the VAT phrasing from Tax. Olga — can you confirm we have Acme's VAT certificate on file (Ana attached it to the original message) and whether Acme wants the credit applied or refunded?

[attachment: draft_credit_memo_20260915.pdf (application/pdf, 38KB)]

Marcus

Hi Marcus / Olga,

Thanks for the fast review. Acme prefers a credit memo applied against our next invoice rather than a refund. PO to apply: ACME-PO-2026-331.

Please include the VAT ID on the credit memo and the reissued invoice exactly as it appears on our certificate: IE3521749V (no punctuation). We'll need the credit in our system by 2026-10-05 to close September books.

Let me know if you need any additional paperwork and if you can confirm the expected posting date.

Regards,
Ana
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>

Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 17 Sep 2026 16:02:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Overremit on August invoice — duplicate remittance and VAT handling

Ana,

All set — we've processed the credit as requested. Summary: 
- Credit memo: CM-20260917-ACME for EUR 48,120.00 (gross) issued and will be applied to upcoming invoices.
- Reissued invoice: INV-202608-9982-R attached (shows reverse charge where applicable and includes IE3521749V).
- Posting date: credit will appear on your account and in HubSpot tonight (target posting 2026-09-17 23:59 UTC).

Attachments: credit_memo_20260917.pdf, invoice_20260917-reissue.pdf

If you need a formal refund later, we can arrange it but since you requested credit we've applied it per PO ACME-PO-2026-331. Please confirm receipt so I can close the ticket on our side.

Apologies again for the duplication — we've also updated reconciliation rules to reduce the risk of duplicate snagging from identical amounts with different refs.

Best,
Olga Petrov
Revenue Operations Manager
